Subject: Next steps: stakeholder roles, milestones & procurement checkpoints for Medix POC

Hi Claire/Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed immediate next steps so we have alignment heading into procurement: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: 6-week POC to validate inference latency and cost at 1k qps for anonymized read workloads.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 120ms; token cost < $0.002 for standard prompts; no PII in logs.
- Pilot scope: 3 internal teams, sandbox dataset, Redwood Dedicated trial.

Open items we flagged:
1) Economic buyer confirmation (Tom) — approval path for committed pilot spend.
2) Security checklist — Claire to share initial SOC2 evidence and procurement contact.
3) Contracting timeline — procurement wants T&Cs + SOW by Dec 10.

Proposed immediate next steps (MAP starter):
- I will attach a one-page Mutual Action Plan with milestones and owners (attached: Medix-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx).
- Claire: please confirm procurement contact email and whether your legal needs a redline or a DPA addendum first.
- Tom: can you confirm the expected decision authority and internal sign-off lead?
- Rohan/Marcus: internal owners — Rohan will handle performance validation plan; Marcus will prep a SOC2 evidence bundle.

Can everyone respond with confirmations by EOD Wednesday (Dec 2) so we can lock the SOW timeline?

Thanks — attaching the MAP draft and a short SOC2 evidence summary we discussed.

Best,
Olga

- Legal prefers a redline of Redwood’s standard MSA; they tend to route DPAs separately if necessary. Will confirm if they want an initial mark-up or the final SOW first.
